description: Maritime entities of geographic transportation network of Acclimate is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kilian Kuhla (Potsdam-Institut of Climate Impact Research). maritime_entities.csv: Centroids of maritime entities and coordination of ports used by geographic transportation network of Acclimate XYZ_coordinates.csv: Polygon coordinates of maritime entites XYZ of the East Asian maritime trading route. Used to compute time tropical cyclone passed by based on observed trajectories from IBTrACS [http://ibtracs.unca.edu/]. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
